name: io.github.musharna/ldraw-mcp
title: ldraw-mcp
description: Render LDraw/LEGO models to images with real part geometry via headless Blender + ImportLDraw

environmentVariables.name: LDRAW_MCP_BLENDER
environmentVariables.description: Path to the Blender binary (overrides PATH lookup).

environmentVariables.name: LDRAW_LIBRARY_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Path to the LDraw parts library (default ~/.ldraw).
